definitions.explanation: Used for spots or markings on surfaces, animals, skin, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦てんとう{虫|むし}→てんとう虫：06497_tentoumushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{羽|はね}→羽根：03696_hane⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧{斑点|はんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Ladybugs have black spots on their red wings.

examples.japanese: ⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}い→茶色い：00922_chairoi⟧{斑点|はんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: Brown spots appeared on the banana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{斑点|はんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the hospital because spots appeared on my skin.

notes:
{斑点|はんてん} refers to spots or markings that appear on surfaces — animal fur, fruit skin, human skin, etc.

USAGE:
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斑点|はんてん}: spots on animals (leopards, ladybugs)
- ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斑点|はんてん}: spots on fruit (browning)
- ⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斑点|はんてん}: spots on skin (rashes, age spots)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {斑点|はんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have spots
- {斑点|はんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: spots appear
- {斑点|はんてん}⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: spotted pattern

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: dot, point (abstract, general)
- ⟦{水玉|みずたま}→水玉：16173_mizutama⟧: polka dots (decorative pattern)
- ⟦まだら→まだら：27149_madara⟧: mottled, patchy (irregular pattern)
- ⟦しみ→染み：05426_shimi⟧: stain, blemish (on skin or fabric)
